evidence: Meteorological records for Jiaxing (Zhejiang) include detailed monthly measurements. The recorded measurement for July in the city was 28.5. For the month of Aug, the measurement in Jiaxing (Zhejiang) was exactly 29.4. By September, the corresponding figure for the area had dropped to 26.0. The progressive decline from 28.5 in July through 29.4 in August to 26.0 in September illustrates the characteristic late-summer peak followed by autumnal cooling that has been documented extensively in the literature on Zhejiang's littoral climate zones.\(^{51}\) Jiaxing's proximity to Hangzhou Bay and its role as a transit corridor between Shanghai and Hangzhou have prompted some analysts to treat its readings as a bellwether for broader regional trends, although the PCGF expressly cautions against extrapolating single-municipality data to provincial-level conclusions.
